persona: Assistant store manager in apparel retail stepping up to run a store
resumeText:
Pooja Sharma | Jaipur | pooja.sharma@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Assistant Store Manager, Gulabi Fashion Retail Pvt Ltd, Jaipur (2022 - present)
- Helped the store achieve 108% of its annual store sales targets and lifted units per transaction from 1.8 to 2.3.
- Executed planograms and seasonal window displays as per brand VM guidelines.
- Planned weekly staff rostering for 18 staff based on footfall and sale events.
- Trained new joiners on product knowledge, billing and service standards.
- Ran monthly store inventory audits and cut shrinkage from 0.9% to 0.5% of sales.
- Handled walk-in customer complaints and improved mystery shopper scores from 78 to 91.
- Supervised 10 sales associates on the floor during the evening shift.

Sales Associate, Amber Lifestyle Stores, Jaipur (2019 - 2022)
- Sold apparel and accessories and handled POS billing.

SKILLS
Store P&L, MS Excel, POS, visual merchandising

EDUCATION
BBA, University of Rajasthan, 2019
